Your postmortem answer is posted in #inc-vtg-hartford, replying to your message.

You first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug. At that point the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. The guard next shows up at 11:03 AM, when Mateo reported kiosk 1 back and the guard checking in trailer 8836. Your 11:08 AM message says both lanes were working as of 11:07.
